metadata.title: AI Watch: India institution-and-system dataset
metadata.scope: 144 named system/service families: the preserved 72-record release plus 72 scaling-cohort additions. The original six-institution frame still associates 26 records. Selection is purposive, not a census or representative national sample. Government enabling infrastructure, statutory-body services, proposed systems, historical internal/defence capabilities and qualified algorithmic contexts are explicitly distinguished from verified live public-facing AI.
metadata.unit: System/service family linked to institutions and observations; not necessarily a live deployment
metadata.review: Single analyst; original-baseline source recheck scope unchanged. Fresh requests, cached recovery and default cached extraction distinguished; not independent duplicate coding, live-operation audit or user-demand validation

issues.description: Trinetra legacy record is kept inside YAKSH family rather than counted as another new named system. AI rankings are not proven risk estimates.
Earlier beta and later announcements are retained, not collapsed into one first-deployment date.
Under-development 2026 description versus launched-in-2024 backgrounder; cannot infer full predictive-policing rollout.
No-PII bank-interface description and I4C suspect-registry intelligence/training arrangement have different scopes; blanket no-data-sharing assurance would be misleading.
Described upload of images/location/date/crop metadata versus app-store no-data-collected declaration. SDK/category definitions and actual processing require further verification.
Earlier seed exclusion is preserved historically. This round includes an explicitly labelled named model-service family under broader infrastructure scope, not proof of citizen-facing deployment.
July reply distinguishes telephone Hindi/English from ten-language web/app/chatbot. The undated 22+ portal remains unreconciled; do not treat every channel as identical.
n.a. A later final regulation or routine SUPACE deployment was not verified after recency searches. This is not proof that neither exists.
n.a. A current government-confirmed rollout inventory and operational audit were not obtained. This is not proof of non-use.

issues.issue_type: Workflow claim is not clinical accuracy
issues.description: 100% high-fidelity-system presentation language is not encoded as AI diagnostic accuracy.
The tender also uses AI for artificial insemination; only explicit AI/ML advisory clauses establish machine-learning attribution.
n.a. Current independent citation, omission and hallucination tests or courtroom outcome evaluations were not verified.
Fraud-risk category and prevented-suspected-transaction amount are not guilt, accuracy or a validated causal loss estimate.
1874 is reported VSS station coverage; not a verified count of stations running each facial recognition or analytics module.
C-DOT cybersecurity TRINETRA is distinct from UP police legacy Trinetra/YAKSH and must not be deduplicated by name alone.
Delhi traffic ITMS and railway track ITMS are different named workflows, not duplicate installations.

A national implementation-study abstract reports expert-clinician validation and implementation, but independent numeric error rates were not established in the retrieved text and full manuscript access was blocked. A separate local 4,401-record study's 90% figure is not the existing national system's score.
Using official datasets is not independent evidence of numerical faithfulness, reliable joins, causal inference or complete coverage.

The dated response supports reported integrated use, not independent safety certification or all October operational details. The programme utilisation study raises privacy and access recommendations, but is not a deployed-CDSS accuracy study.
The reviewed records support assistive translation use, not perfect equivalence or current uniform governance across courts.
Physical installation and functioning ordinary signals do not prove connected central AI operation; differing June counts not silently reconciled.
Version 1 menu-based service and proposed agentic Version 2 are one family, not two systems or proof of completed agentic transactions.
n.a. 'Improved speed and accuracy' is an official qualitative claim, not a production benchmark with error distributions.
The October source confirms reported scaled use, not independently audited accuracy or every current operational detail.
Broad weather-forecast improvements are not assigned as measured accuracy of newly announced AI products.
Headline aggregate 255; four division values 106+14+122+15 sum to 257. Retained unresolved, not interpreted as system failure.
Headline accuracy and prospective multicentre clinical validity are different claims; keep both reporting periods.
Official full-functionality wording retains exceptions; does not establish every relying entity was ready.

OMPTS refers to a mineral-regulatory regime, not an independently verified product name. Registry identifies the documented AI-integrated i3MS dispatch workflow and preserves human variance exceptions.
More than fifty tools is a portfolio description, not fifty new dataset rows or independent performance evaluations.
Official integration is documented as a source claim; live access, coverage and decision impact were not independently tested.
n.a. Independent error, bias, accuracy and workload evaluations were not verified; vendor anecdotes are not benchmarks.
n.a. Independent legal-semantic error rates by language, case type and model version were not verified.
Dated Phase-I Hindi/English versus undated 22+ language portal; later expansion may explain the difference but is not verified.
Broad city deployment descriptions do not establish that the new HMDA master plan is complete.
Do not present an older deployment announcement as uninterrupted current challan processing.
UPSC reports six-to-eight-second typical authentication; no independent false-accept/reject or subgroup evaluation was verified.

August 2025 answer says over 95 lakh queries resolved as of 15 July; February 2026 backgrounder says over 93 lakh queries responded to as of December 2025. Lower bounds and different wording are not necessarily a decrease, but definitions and consistency were not reconciled.
Telangana/Nagpur programme observations retained as deployment context in one family; prospective targets not outcomes.
Stage I T+1, Stage II hourly and Stage III near-real-time are different stages; a live-bank label does not imply Stage III.
